newsitem.title: USA: Techne Corp Q2 net higher on sales boost.
newsitem.headline: Techne Corp Q2 net higher on sales boost.

text.p: Techne Corp said Tuesday a 35-percent increase in net income in the second quarter ended December 31 was primarily attributable to higher sales and lower royalty payments in the period.
The company reported net income of $2.3 million, compared with $1.7 million one year ago. Sales in the quarter reached $14.4 million, versus $12.5 million in the corresponding period in 1995.
Techne's operating subsidiaries develop biotechnology products in North America and Europe.
Its shares were trading up 1/2 Tuesday at 25-1/4.
